FontHandler.Update.desc: Every 100 calls, frees fonts whose reference count dropped to zero via gl.DeleteFont.

FontHandler.UnloadFont.desc: Decrements the given font's reference count (nothing is freed immediately; Update reclaims it later).

FontHandler.LoadFont.desc: Returns a cached font (reference count +1) matching name/size/outline, otherwise loads a new one and caches it.

params.fontname: Font path or filename (a fonts/ prefix is also matched).

module.summary: Font cache: reuse gl.LoadFont handles by name/size/outline with reference counting, releasing them deferred in Update once the count reaches zero.

fileDesc: Font cache with reference counting: reuses gl.LoadFont results by name, size and outline args, releasing them lazily in Update once the reference count reaches zero.
